BMMInfluencerCategory.Documentation: A rival enterprise in a struggle for advantage over the subject enterprise.
BMMInfluencerCategory.Documentation_plain: A rival enterprise in a struggle for advantage over the subject enterprise.

BMMInfluencerCategory.Documentation: A role played by an individual or enterprise that has investigated, ordered, received, or paid for products or services from the subject enterprise.

BMMInfluencerCategory.Documentation: An enterprise that shares risks and profit with the subject enterprise (or is associated with the subject enterprise to share risks and profit) because this is mutually beneficial.

BMMInfluencerCategory.Documentation: A role played by an individual or enterprise that can furnish or provide products or services to the subject enterprise.

NOTE.Documentation:
R1. Symmetry of Alignment

Statement:

If one StandardConcept aligns with another StandardConcept, then the second StandardConcept also aligns with the first StandardConcept.

Formal rule:

aligns(StandardConcept1, StandardConcept2)

<-> aligns(StandardConcept2, StandardConcept1)
NOTE.Documentation_plain:
R1. Symmetry of Alignment
Statement: If one StandardConcept aligns with another StandardConcept, then the second StandardConcept also aligns with the first StandardConcept.
Formal rule: aligns(StandardConcept1, StandardConcept2) <-> aligns(StandardConcept2, StandardConcept1)

NOTE.Documentation:
R2. Propagation of a ModelConcept Mapping to its Implemented StandardConcept

Statement:

If a ModelConcept implements a StandardConcept, and the ModelConcept hriv:hasExactMeaning to an OntologyConcept, then the implemented StandardConcept also hriv:hasExactMeaning to the same OntologyConcept.

Formal rule:

implements(ModelConcept1, StandardConcept1)

and hriv:hasExactMeaning(ModelConcept1, OntologyConcept1)

-> hriv:hasExactMeaning(StandardConcept1, OntologyConcept1)

Inference metadata:

The inferred StandardMapping must have provenance = inferred.
NOTE.Documentation_plain:
R2. Propagation of a ModelConcept Mapping to its Implemented StandardConcept
Statement: If a ModelConcept implements a StandardConcept, and the ModelConcept hriv:hasExactMeaning to an OntologyConcept, then the implemented StandardConcept also hriv:hasExactMeaning to the same OntologyConcept.
Formal rule: implements(ModelConcept1, StandardConcept1) and hriv:hasExactMeaning(ModelConcept1, OntologyConcept1) -> hriv:hasExactMeaning(StandardConcept1, OntologyConcept1)
Inference metadata: The inferred StandardMapping must have provenance = inferred.

NOTE.Documentation:
R3. Propagation of a StandardConcept Mapping to its Implementing ModelConcept

Statement:

If a ModelConcept implements a StandardConcept, and the StandardConcept maps to an OntologyConcept, then the implementing ModelConcept also maps to the same OntologyConcept.

Formal rule:

implements(ModelConcept1, StandardConcept1)

and maps(StandardConcept1, OntologyConcept1)

-> maps(ModelConcept1, OntologyConcept1)

Inference metadata:

The inferred ModelMapping must have provenance = inferred.
NOTE.Documentation_plain:
R3. Propagation of a StandardConcept Mapping to its Implementing ModelConcept
Statement: If a ModelConcept implements a StandardConcept, and the StandardConcept maps to an OntologyConcept, then the implementing ModelConcept also maps to the same OntologyConcept.
Formal rule: implements(ModelConcept1, StandardConcept1) and maps(StandardConcept1, OntologyConcept1) -> maps(ModelConcept1, OntologyConcept1)
Inference metadata: The inferred ModelMapping must have provenance = inferred.

NOTE.Documentation:
R3. Alignment Inferred from a Shared Implementing ModelConcept

Statement:

If the same ModelConcept implements two distinct StandardConcept instances, then those two StandardConcept instances are aligned.

Formal rule:

implements(ModelConcept1, StandardConcept1)

and implements(ModelConcept1, StandardConcept2)

and StandardConcept1 != StandardConcept2

-> aligns(StandardConcept1, StandardConcept2)

Inference metadata:

The inferred Alignment must have provenance = inferred.
NOTE.Documentation_plain:
R3. Alignment Inferred from a Shared Implementing ModelConcept
Statement: If the same ModelConcept implements two distinct StandardConcept instances, then those two StandardConcept instances are aligned.
Formal rule: implements(ModelConcept1, StandardConcept1) and implements(ModelConcept1, StandardConcept2) and StandardConcept1 != StandardConcept2 -> aligns(StandardConcept1, StandardConcept2)
Inference metadata: The inferred Alignment must have provenance = inferred.

NOTE.Documentation:
R4. Propagation of a StandardConcept Mapping Across an Alignment

Statement:

If one StandardConcept aligns with another StandardConcept, and the first StandardConcept hriv:hasExactMeaning to an OntologyConcept, then the second StandardConcept also hriv:hasExactMeaning to the same OntologyConcept.

Formal rule:

aligns(StandardConcept1, StandardConcept2)

and hriv:hasExactMeaning(StandardConcept1, OntologyConcept1)

-> hriv:hasExactMeaning(StandardConcept2, OntologyConcept1)

Inference metadata:

The inferred StandardMapping must have provenance = inferred.
NOTE.Documentation_plain:
R4. Propagation of a StandardConcept Mapping Across an Alignment
Statement: If one StandardConcept aligns with another StandardConcept, and the first StandardConcept hriv:hasExactMeaning to an OntologyConcept, then the second StandardConcept also hriv:hasExactMeaning to the same OntologyConcept.
Formal rule: aligns(StandardConcept1, StandardConcept2) and hriv:hasExactMeaning(StandardConcept1, OntologyConcept1) -> hriv:hasExactMeaning(StandardConcept2, OntologyConcept1)
Inference metadata: The inferred StandardMapping must have provenance = inferred.

NOTE.Documentation:
R5. Alignment Inferred from a Shared OntologyConcept Mapping

Statement:

If two distinct StandardConcept instances both hriv:hasExactMeaning to the same OntologyConcept, then those two StandardConcept instances are aligned.

Formal rule:

hriv:hasExactMeaning(StandardConcept1, OntologyConcept1)

and hriv:hasExactMeaning(StandardConcept2, OntologyConcept1)

and StandardConcept1 != StandardConcept2

-> aligns(StandardConcept1, StandardConcept2)

Inference metadata:

The inferred Alignment must have provenance = inferred.
NOTE.Documentation_plain:
R5. Alignment Inferred from a Shared OntologyConcept Mapping
Statement: If two distinct StandardConcept instances both hriv:hasExactMeaning to the same OntologyConcept, then those two StandardConcept instances are aligned.
Formal rule: hriv:hasExactMeaning(StandardConcept1, OntologyConcept1) and hriv:hasExactMeaning(StandardConcept2, OntologyConcept1) and StandardConcept1 != StandardConcept2 -> aligns(StandardConcept1, StandardConcept2)
Inference metadata: The inferred Alignment must have provenance = inferred.

NOTE.Documentation:
R6. Propagation of a Negative StandardConcept Mapping Across an Alignment

Statement:

If a StandardConcept negatively hriv:hasExactMeaning to an OntologyConcept, and that StandardConcept aligns with another StandardConcept, then the other StandardConcept also negatively hriv:hasExactMeaning to the same OntologyConcept.

Formal rule:

aligns(StandardConcept1, StandardConcept2)

and hriv:hasExactMeaning(StandardConcept1, OntologyConcept1)

and polarity(StandardConcept1, OntologyConcept1) = negative

-> hriv:hasExactMeaning(StandardConcept2, OntologyConcept1)

and polarity(StandardConcept2, OntologyConcept1) = negative

Inference metadata:

The inferred StandardMapping must have provenance = inferred.
NOTE.Documentation_plain:
R6. Propagation of a Negative StandardConcept Mapping Across an Alignment
Statement: If a StandardConcept negatively hriv:hasExactMeaning to an OntologyConcept, and that StandardConcept aligns with another StandardConcept, then the other StandardConcept also negatively hriv:hasExactMeaning to the same OntologyConcept.
Formal rule: aligns(StandardConcept1, StandardConcept2) and hriv:hasExactMeaning(StandardConcept1, OntologyConcept1) and polarity(StandardConcept1, OntologyConcept1) = negative -> hriv:hasExactMeaning(StandardConcept2, OntologyConcept1) and polarity(StandardConcept2, OntologyConcept1) = negative
Inference metadata: The inferred StandardMapping must have provenance = inferred.

NOTE.Documentation:
R7. Incompatibility Between Negative and Positive Mappings to the Same OntologyConcept

Statement:

Two StandardConcept instances must not align if one negatively hriv:hasExactMeaning to an OntologyConcept and the other positively hriv:hasExactMeaning to the same OntologyConcept.

Forbidden condition:

aligns(StandardConcept1, StandardConcept2)

and hriv:hasExactMeaning(StandardConcept1, OntologyConcept1)

and polarity(StandardConcept1, OntologyConcept1) = negative

and hriv:hasExactMeaning(StandardConcept2, OntologyConcept1)

and polarity(StandardConcept2, OntologyConcept1) = positive
NOTE.Documentation_plain:
R7. Incompatibility Between Negative and Positive Mappings to the Same OntologyConcept
Statement: Two StandardConcept instances must not align if one negatively hriv:hasExactMeaning to an OntologyConcept and the other positively hriv:hasExactMeaning to the same OntologyConcept.
Forbidden condition: aligns(StandardConcept1, StandardConcept2) and hriv:hasExactMeaning(StandardConcept1, OntologyConcept1) and polarity(StandardConcept1, OntologyConcept1) = negative and hriv:hasExactMeaning(StandardConcept2, OntologyConcept1) and polarity(StandardConcept2, OntologyConcept1) = positive
